levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify distance and travel in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain distance and travel and connect it to maps and routes without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use measurement in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from We the Travellers – 2 and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on We the Travellers – 2.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.
